headline: AvalonBay Communities (AVB) Could Be 8% Below Fair Value As Merger Plans Progress
summary: AvalonBay Communities (AVB) is in focus after updating investors on its share repurchase activity and reporting second quarter 2026 results, along with progress on its planned merger into Vivmark Residential.
